description: Swahiliti ni East Africa e’yo, ba ambo ndra a’yo ni Mombasa ka Zanzibar ni ani Kampala, Kigali ka Goma.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lugbara courses (#132) with low confidence in Lugbara; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: E’yo **East Africa dria ni.**
why.text: Swahiliti ni e’yo Kenya, Tanzania ka Uganda ni, ba a’yo suku alia ka azi vu ii amboa gere ni ani Congo. Imba geri ndizu ni, biasara ni, agyi ndrezu ni ka ongo erizu ni.

cards.title: Ba ndi geri dria ni
cards.text: Ndi Mombasa ni ani Mwanza takisi ya jahazi ya si.

cards.title: Azi vu
cards.text: Azi ngu ozi bayi ka ogu bayi be East Africa dria.

cards.title: Ba le e’yo ni ni
cards.text: Ndre e’yo ati, e’yo ndra’bo niyi ka ongoyi ii amboa gere ni.

landing.audience: Ba Lugbarati a’yo ni etozu ni: ba ndi geri dria ni, ozi bayi ka azi bayi East Africa alia.
landing.first: Ngoni, ru a’yozu ka nde, vutia aku ba, nyaka, suku, sawa, vu, jo ka ruakini, alu alu.
